display_name: Hot Shots Tennis Native 60 Hz Logic (Experimental)

rng_policy.reason: I keep the same odds: every per-update random check keeps running each 60 Hz update with its probability halved, so event odds per second of real time match the 30 Hz game. Rolls are inline per-object LCGs, so the generator advances about twice as often per second; the timing harness records RNG consumption per second as an expected 2x difference and checks event frequencies per second (AI shot choices, rally outcomes, crowd and other random events) against authentic within tolerance.
